svg.title: How a user connects to a Cloud PC and how you check it
svg.desc: The user signs in to Windows App or the web client at windows.cloud.microsoft with the licensed work account. Microsoft Entra ID handles the sign-in, and Conditional Access can apply. The connection goes through the Azure Virtual Desktop service, which Windows 365 uses for Cloud PC connections. The client and the Cloud PC both connect outward to the service, so there is no inbound connection from the internet to the Cloud PC. The Cloud PC is Microsoft Entra joined and enrolled in Intune. The Remote Desktop Connection tool, mstsc.exe, is not a supported daily connection method. The administrator checks the Cloud PC status in All Cloud PCs and the device record, primary user, join type and last check-in in All devices in the Intune admin center.
svg.text: The Cloud PC tile shows the
Signs in the licensed work account
No inbound connection from the internet
Primary user, join type, last check-in
The device object, to confirm the join
